toolDescription.zh-CN: 把一份 json-render spec 渲染成 Pi 终端面板，直接显示在会话里。spec 是扁平结构：root 指向元素 key，elements 是 key → { type, props, children } 的映射。组件名单、props 签名和示例见组件参考文件（路径见工具说明中的 catalog 路径），写 spec 前先读它。
toolDescription.en-US: Render a json-render spec as a Pi terminal panel inside the session. The spec is flat: root names an element key, elements maps key to { type, props, children }. The component list, prop signatures, and examples live in the component reference file (see the catalog path in this tool description); read it before authoring a spec.

toolSnippet.zh-CN: 把 json-render JSON spec 渲染成终端面板；写 spec 前先读组件参考文件。
toolSnippet.en-US: Render a json-render JSON spec as a terminal panel; read the component reference before authoring a spec.

catalogPointer.zh-CN: 组件参考文件（先用 read 工具读取）：{path}
catalogPointer.en-US: Component reference (read it first with the read tool): {path}

guidelineCatalog.zh-CN: 调用 render_ui 之前，先用 read 工具读取工具说明里给出的组件参考文件，按其中的组件名、props 签名和规则编写 spec；不要凭记忆编造组件或 props。
guidelineCatalog.en-US: Before calling render_ui, read the component reference file named in the tool description and follow its component names, prop signatures, and rules. Do not invent components or props from memory.

guidelineShape.zh-CN: spec 必须包含 root 和 elements；每个元素都要有 children 数组（叶子节点写 []），children 里只能填 elements 中已存在的 key。
guidelineShape.en-US: A spec must contain root and elements; every element needs a children array (use [] for leaves), and every key inside children must exist in elements.

guidelineInteractive.zh-CN: 需要用户选择、输入或确认时，在 spec 里使用 Select/MultiSelect/TextInput/ConfirmInput/Tabs 并把值绑定到 state；工具会打开可交互面板，用户操作后的最终 state 会返回给你。
guidelineInteractive.en-US: When the user must choose, type, or confirm something, use Select/MultiSelect/TextInput/ConfirmInput/Tabs in the spec and bind their values to state. The tool opens an interactive panel and returns the final state after the user acts.

commandDescription.zh-CN: 打开 pi-gen-ui 配置面板；带参数时按参数改单项配置，并输出组件参考文件路径
commandDescription.en-US: Open the pi-gen-ui configuration panel, or change one setting by argument, and print the component reference path

commandUsage.zh-CN: 用法：/config:gen-ui 打开配置面板；也可带参数 enable|disable|status|reset|provider <auto|typesafe|gateway>|model <id>|composition <on|off>|catalog
commandUsage.en-US: Usage: /config:gen-ui opens the configuration panel; arguments: enable|disable|status|reset|provider <auto|typesafe|gateway>|model <id>|composition <on|off>|catalog

configViewAuto.zh-CN: spec 用到交互组件时才打开
configViewAuto.en-US: Only when the spec uses interactive components

configProviderAuto.zh-CN: 自动（优先 TypeSafe 直连）

configDescEnabled.zh-CN: 关闭后 render_ui 与 compose_ui 都不再工作；渲染和组合都会拒绝执行。
configDescEnabled.en-US: When off, neither render_ui nor compose_ui runs: rendering and composition are both refused.

configDescInteractiveView.zh-CN: 决定何时接管键盘打开可交互面板；默认只在 spec 用到交互组件时打开。
configDescInteractiveView.en-US: When the keyboard-interactive panel takes over input; by default only for specs that use interactive components.

configDescMaxResultLines.zh-CN: 渲染结果超过这个行数就折叠，展开工具结果可看全部。
configDescMaxResultLines.en-US: Rendered results longer than this collapse; expand the tool result to see everything.

configDescCompositionEnabled.zh-CN: 由决策模型从候选元素里挑拣组合；关闭后 compose_ui 会拒绝执行，render_ui 不受影响。
configDescCompositionEnabled.en-US: Let the decision model select and arrange candidates; when off, compose_ui refuses to run and render_ui is unaffected.

configDescProvider.zh-CN: 自动模式优先 TypeSafe 直连，没有对应 key 时退回 Vercel AI Gateway；钉死某个通道后不再回退。
configDescProvider.en-US: Auto prefers the TypeSafe direct call and falls back to Vercel AI Gateway when its key is missing; pinning a transport disables the fallback.

configDescModel.zh-CN: 送给组合通道的模型 id；只有通道认得的模型可用，留「按通道默认」即用 jev-latest 或 typesafe-ai/jev。
configDescModel.en-US: Model id sent to the composition transport; only models the transport knows work. Leave it on the channel default for jev-latest or typesafe-ai/jev.

configDescApiKeyEnv.zh-CN: 读取 key 的环境变量名；留空用通道默认（TYPESAFE_API_KEY 或 AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY）。
configDescApiKeyEnv.en-US: Environment variable holding the key; leave empty for the transport default (TYPESAFE_API_KEY or AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY).

configDescEndpoint.zh-CN: 仅 TypeSafe 直连使用；留空走官方端点。
configDescEndpoint.en-US: Only used by the TypeSafe direct transport; leave empty for the official endpoint.

configDescTimeout.zh-CN: 单次评估请求的毫秒上限，超时按失败回报，不会静默降级。
configDescTimeout.en-US: Milliseconds allowed per evaluation request; a timeout is reported as a failure, never silently degraded.

configReset.zh-CN: pi-gen-ui 配置已恢复默认值

configResetFailed.en-US: Failed to restore the default configuration: {path} ({error})

disabled.zh-CN: pi-gen-ui 已禁用；render_ui 与 compose_ui 立即停止工作
disabled.en-US: pi-gen-ui disabled; render_ui and compose_ui stop working immediately

status.zh-CN: pi-gen-ui：{state}；结果最多显示 {maxLines} 行；交互面板 {view}；组合 {composition}；组件参考：{catalog}
status.en-US: pi-gen-ui: {state}; results show at most {maxLines} lines; interactive panel {view}; composition {composition}; component reference: {catalog}

configLoadFailed.zh-CN: pi-gen-ui 配置读取失败：{path}（{error}）。当前使用默认配置。
configLoadFailed.en-US: Failed to read pi-gen-ui configuration: {path} ({error}). Defaults are in effect.

toolDisabled.zh-CN: pi-gen-ui 已禁用；使用 /config:gen-ui enable 启用后重试。
toolDisabled.en-US: pi-gen-ui is disabled; run /config:gen-ui enable and retry.

specMissingRoot.zh-CN: spec 缺少 root 或 elements（root 必须是字符串，elements 必须是对象）。参考：{catalog}
specMissingRoot.en-US: The spec is missing root or elements (root must be a string, elements must be an object). Reference: {catalog}

specInvalid.zh-CN: spec 结构校验未通过：\n{issues}\n请修正后重新调用。参考：{catalog}
specInvalid.en-US: The spec failed structural validation:\n{issues}\nFix these and call render_ui again. Reference: {catalog}

specPropsInvalid.zh-CN: spec 的 props 不符合 catalog：\n{issues}\n请修正后重新调用。参考：{catalog}
specPropsInvalid.en-US: The spec props do not match the catalog:\n{issues}\nFix these and call render_ui again. Reference: {catalog}

resultSummary.zh-CN: 已渲染 {elements} 个元素（{components} 个组件）。

resultInteractive.zh-CN: 用户已操作交互面板，最终 state：{state}
resultInteractive.en-US: The user interacted with the panel. Final state: {state}

resultWarnings.zh-CN: {count} 项简化或问题（未静默忽略）：\n{details}
resultWarnings.en-US: {count} simplification(s) or problem(s), reported rather than silently dropped:\n{details}

resultTruncated.zh-CN: … 还有 {count} 行未显示，展开工具结果查看全部。
resultTruncated.en-US: … {count} more line(s) hidden; expand the tool result to see everything.

resultNotTui.zh-CN: 当前模式不支持终端面板渲染（模式：{mode}），仅返回 spec 摘要。
resultNotTui.en-US: The current mode cannot render terminal panels (mode: {mode}); only a spec summary is returned.

catalogCommandFailed.zh-CN: 生成组件参考文件失败：{path}（{error}）
catalogCommandFailed.en-US: Failed to write the component reference: {path} ({error})

composeToolDescription.zh-CN: 用 TypeSafe 的决策模型（Jev）从你提供的候选元素里挑选并组合出面板，而不是自己手写整棵元素树。你负责提供原子候选（组件名 + 具体 props 值 + 说明）和 state；Jev 只决定包含哪些、顺序和位置，不会发明 props 值、也不会执行 action。默认自动选用可用的凭据：优先 TypeSafe 直连（TYPESAFE_API_KEY），否则用 Vercel AI Gateway（AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY）。这是上游 experimental API，可能随版本变化。
composeToolDescription.en-US: Use TypeSafe's decision model (Jev) to select and arrange a panel from candidates you provide, instead of hand-authoring the whole element tree. You supply atomic candidates (component name plus concrete prop values plus a description) and state; Jev decides only what to include, in what order, and where. It never invents prop values and never executes actions. Credentials are auto-detected: TypeSafe direct (TYPESAFE_API_KEY) is preferred, otherwise Vercel AI Gateway (AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY). This is an upstream experimental API and may change between releases.

composeToolSnippet.zh-CN: 让决策模型从候选元素里组合出面板；候选需带具体 props 值与说明。
composeToolSnippet.en-US: Let a decision model compose a panel from candidate elements; each candidate needs concrete prop values and a description.

composeGuidelineCandidates.zh-CN: 调用 compose_ui 时，每个候选元素必须带具体的 props 值、真实的文案和数据，并写清 description（Jev 只能根据 description 判断是否使用）；把值绑定到 state 用 $state 表达式。开放式字符串内容和数据必须由你准备好，Jev 不会填值。
composeGuidelineCandidates.en-US: With compose_ui, every candidate element needs concrete prop values, real copy and data, and a clear description, since Jev can only judge a candidate from its description. Bind values to state with $state expressions. Open-ended strings, copy, and data must already be provided: Jev does not fill values in.

composeGuidelineFallback.zh-CN: compose_ui 需要可用的凭据（TYPESAFE_API_KEY 或 AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY），可能因缺凭据、网络或 provider 权限失败。失败时不要重试同一调用，直接用 render_ui 自己写 spec。
composeGuidelineFallback.en-US: compose_ui needs usable credentials (TYPESAFE_API_KEY or AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY) and can fail on missing credentials, network, or provider access. When it fails, do not retry the same call: author the spec yourself with render_ui instead.

composeDisabled.zh-CN: compose_ui 已在配置中禁用（composition.enabled=false）；用 /config:gen-ui 打开面板改，立即生效，不用重启。也可以直接用 render_ui 手写 spec。
composeDisabled.en-US: compose_ui is disabled in configuration (composition.enabled=false). Change it in the /config:gen-ui panel; it applies immediately with no restart. You can also author the spec directly with render_ui.

composeMissingKey.zh-CN: compose_ui 没有找到可用的 API key（provider 设置为 {provider}）。默认自动模式会优先用 TYPESAFE_API_KEY 直连 TypeSafe，找不到再用 AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY 走 Vercel AI Gateway。请设置其中一个环境变量并重启 Pi，或在配置里指定 composition.apiKeyEnv；也可以直接用 render_ui 手写 spec。
composeMissingKey.en-US: compose_ui found no usable API key (provider is set to {provider}). In the default auto mode it prefers TYPESAFE_API_KEY for a direct TypeSafe call and falls back to AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY through Vercel AI Gateway. Set one of those environment variables and restart Pi, or name the variable with composition.apiKeyEnv; you can also author the spec directly with render_ui.

composeUnsupportedCore.zh-CN: 当前安装的 @json-render/core 不再提供 experimental_composeSpec/experimental_createEvaluator（上游 experimental API 已变更）。请用 render_ui 手写 spec，或把 @json-render/core 固定到可用版本。
composeUnsupportedCore.en-US: The installed @json-render/core no longer provides experimental_composeSpec/experimental_createEvaluator, so the upstream experimental API has changed. Author the spec with render_ui, or pin @json-render/core to a version that still exposes it.

composeFailed.zh-CN:
组合失败：{error}
不要重试同一调用，改用 render_ui 自己写 spec。参考：{catalog}
composeFailed.en-US:
Composition failed: {error}
Do not retry the same call; author the spec with render_ui instead. Reference: {catalog}

composeStoppedAtLimit.zh-CN: 组合达到元素或步骤上限后停止，返回的是当前能给出的最好结果。
composeStoppedAtLimit.en-US: Composition stopped at the element or step budget; the result is the best tree it produced.

composeStoppedUnavailable.zh-CN: 组合未能产出可用的树（evaluator 不可用或没有满足条件的候选）。请调整候选或改用 render_ui。参考：{catalog}
composeStoppedUnavailable.en-US: Composition produced no usable tree (the evaluator was unavailable or no candidate fit). Adjust the candidates or use render_ui. Reference: {catalog}

composeSummary.zh-CN: 组合完成：{elements} 个元素，{steps} 步，{elapsed}ms。
